unique_original_math: For two congruent concentric squares, reflection about their orientation bisector swaps the squares and maps AB to the adjacent BC. Quarterturn symmetry gives four congruent removed corner triangles. These are symmetries of the whole arrangement, not new drawn relation symbols.
Let the NE corner triangle legs be p,q and its hypotenuse BC=a=43/99. The complete horizontal unit side consists of q,AB,p, so p+q=1-a=56/99; p^2+q^2=a^2 by Pythagoras.
2pq=(p+q)^2-(p^2+q^2)=(56^2-43^2)/99^2=13/99. Four removed triangle areas total2pq=13/99. Intersection area=86/99 in lowest terms and m+n=185 uniquely.
The wrong isosceles assumption would give one triangle area a^2/4 and all four a^2, hence1-a^2=7952/9801 (coprime) and17753. Actual p≈0.1630983,q≈0.4025583, so p!=q. No label or fill is changed.
